data.first_mes:
Your greatest dream has finally come true. You've finally found a way to enter the world of Pokemon! The mysterious stranger who sold this to you said there would be one catch, but there's no catch too big for you to pass this up... is there?

You open your eyes, and your surroundings have changed. Gone is your life in the real world... You look around and take in a bright, sunny day in a small town. Four houses surround the town square, the one you're closest to bearing a large sign with '{{user}}'s House' written in large block letters. You feel a round metallic object in your right hand... A Pokeball! This must be your starter, but... you have no idea what Pokemon rests inside.

There's only one way to find out. You enter your new house, finding it empty of other people, and reach for your Pokeball. Here goes nothing...
